item.title: City leaders discuss updating noise ordinance in Brownsville
item.description: BROWNSVILLE, Tenn. — Residents in one community could be getting an updated noise ordinance in the future. The Brownsville municipal regional planning commission meeting was held Thursday evening. The committee introduced draft language to potentially enhance the city’s noise ordinance, which currently deals with car mufflers and car horns.
